steps: High-flow oxygen to SpO2 94–98%; back-to-back nebulised salbutamol (+ ipratropium if severe).
Oral prednisolone 40–50 mg (or IV hydrocortisone) early.
IV magnesium sulfate for severe/life-threatening attacks.
Reassess with PEF/ABG; escalate to ICU for exhaustion, rising CO2 or silent chest.
Identify trigger; review inhaler technique/adherence and step-up preventer at discharge.

confirm: Acute wheeze/dyspnoea/cough with reduced PEF; grade severity (PEF, SpO2, ability to speak, silent chest).
disposition: Admit if not responding; ICU if life-threatening.
